card.name: Judging Light
card.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

card.name: Judgment
card.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
card.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

source.originalText: Judgment: Smites mark enemies with Judged for 2 rounds, reducing their AC by 1.

card.name: Balanced Scales
card.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures healed by your Cleric features
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per marked ally per round
card.effect: Balanced Scales. Tags: priest, healing, retaliation. After you restore HP to a living ally, mark it until the start of your next regular turn. The first enemy to damage that ally during the mark takes S + M radiant damage. The retaliation is not an attack, cannot critically hit and cannot recursively trigger another Balanced Scales event.

source.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

card.name: Word of Binding
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six enemies within 30 feet
card.effect: Final Miracle — Word of Binding. Tags: priest, finale, control, rite. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Silenced and its Speed becomes 0. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending both effects on success. While a target remains bound, the first instance of divine or radiant damage it takes each round gains S d6 additional radiant damage. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Final Miracle: Word of Binding: Enemies in a large AoE are silenced, snared, and take +25% divine damage for 3 turns.

card.name: Divine Judgment
card.effect: Divine Judgment. Tags: priest, judgment. The target makes a Wisdom save; success ends the attempt. On failure it is marked. The first time on each of its turns that it deals damage to another creature, it takes radiant damage equal to half that actual damage rounded down, minimum 1, maximum your Cleric level. It repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending the mark on success.

source.originalText: Divine Judgment: Mark an enemy for judgment, causing them to take damage proportional to the harm they inflict.

card.name: Ritual of Undeath
card.rangeAndTarget: One eligible corpse within 30 feet or one living ally within 30 feet
card.effect: Ritual of Undeath. Tags: cultist, undead, rite. Choose one mode. Corpse Servant: one humanoid corpse dead no more than 1 minute rises for 3 rounds as a temporary thrall with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet and one attack only when you spend your shared companion Bonus Action command using your Cleric technique attack bonus; on hit it deals S d6 necrotic. The thrall disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and grants no XP, loot, new corpse, Conviction or resurrection target. Death Ward: one living ally is marked for 1 minute; the first time it would die during that duration, it instead remains at 1 HP and counts as both humanoid and undead until the end of its next turn. Neither mode removes Wounds. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Ritual of Undeath: Perform a forbidden ritual that can temporarily raise fallen enemies as servants or prevent allies from dying by transforming them into undead-like entities.

text: One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed, except Phantom Strike, which explicitly may apply the mark without Bleed. It does not add a free Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

card.name: Blood Mark
card.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
card.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

source.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

card.name: Rupture Trigger
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
card.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

source.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

card.name: Rupture
card.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

source.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

card.name: Veinjammer
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your Bleed
card.effect: After a Bleed tick, choose that victim: Speed reduced 5 ft, minimum 0, and its next concentration save takes-1. Nonstacking; does not remove an Action or prohibit spellcasting.

source.originalText: Veinjammer: Bleeds reduce enemy casting and action speed by 10%.

card.name: Phantom Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; must be hidden from it
card.effect: Make one weapon attack with advantage. On hit add S d6 damage and apply a mark without its usual BG cost, even if not already bleeding. The mark replaces your old mark; no free Rupture occurs. Normal hit BG gain still capped.

source.originalText: Phantom Strike: Attack from stealth with increased critical chance and apply a Blood Mark automatically.

card.name: Carrion Conductor
card.rangeAndTarget: One fresh hostile living-combatant corpse within 30 ft
card.effect: Mark the corpse once; on activation or before expiry use Reaction to burst it. Up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success. Corpse cannot be reused, raised by this effect or provide BG/kill triggers.

source.originalText: Carrion Conductor: Corpses leave behind blood pools that explode for AoE damage.

card.name: Drake Mark
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your leap
card.effect: Mark that creature; your first subsequent direct polearm hit adds S damage. A new mark replaces old. No extra damage to the triggering leap, Do Ts or copies; it is not a spell mark.

source.originalText: Drake Mark: Each leap attack marks enemies. Marked enemies take +10% damage from you.

card.name: Winter's Embrace
card.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn inside CON save or 1d6 cold and Speed-10 ft through end turn. Once/enemy/round; success no effect. Does not stack multiple slows or affect flying targets outside sphere.

source.originalText:
Winter's Embrace
Beginning at 6th level, you can surround yourself with an aura of biting cold. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Snow Leopard
card.effect: Claw 2d6+WIS cold, +1d4 once/turn against slowed foe. +5 Stealth on ice/snow and advantage on legal Hide there; source+10 reduced provisionally. Ignore ordinary ice/snow movement penalties, not magical restraining ice.

source.originalText:
Snow Leopard
Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 cold damage
Stealth: You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in snowy or icy terrain
Frost Walk: You can move across icy surfaces without making ability checks and through snow without penalty

text: Before the irreversible Lich roll, the Director must explicitly tell the player the historical failure stakes: permanent loss of spellcasting, transformation into a cursed melee undead NPC, hostile faction consequences, cursed-gear restriction and no further XP as that retired PC. The player must explicitly opt into that retirement risk before rolling. If the player declines, the ritual stops before the roll and the character must choose another Hero path for this playtest; no irreversible consequence is applied.

card.name: Elemental Bolt
card.effect: Elemental Bolt. Tags: mage-spell, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal S d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire: target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Cold: Speed -10 feet until the end of its next turn. Lightning: one different enemy within 10 feet takes S lightning damage. Secondary damage creates no new spell cast or chain credit.

source.originalText: Elemental Bolt: Cast a bolt of your chosen element (once selected) that deals additional effects based on the element.

card.name: Cold
card.cost: 0; Glacier Spike costs 2 RP when primed
card.duration: Permanent Focus; finisher instantaneous plus slow
card.frequency: Choose at Mage 2; finisher recharge 3 rounds
card.effect: Elemental Focus — Cold. Tags: focus, cold. Once on each of your turns, a natural 19 that hits with a Cold Mage spell is a critical hit. When a Cold Mage spell damages a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, minimum 0. FINISHER — Glacier Spike: after a completed Cold Nuke Chain, Bonus Action, 2 RP. Creatures in a 15-foot cone make Constitution saves, taking (S+1)d8 cold on failure or half on success; failed creatures have their Speed halved until the end of their next turn.

source.originalText: Cold: +5% crit chance, slows targets. Finisher: Glacier Spike – Cone AoE, 50% slow

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: arcanist, focus. Improve the secondary effect of your current Focus. Fire Burns from your Focus cards last one additional turn but never stack. Cold Focus Speed reductions increase by another 5 feet, minimum 0. Lightning Focus's once-per-turn secondary arc increases from S flat lightning damage to S d4 lightning damage. Pivoted Focus uses the corresponding upgraded rider.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Increase the effectiveness of your chosen element's secondary effects.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Elemental Surge. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal (S+1)d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire also applies the Focus Burn; Cold applies the Focus Speed reduction; Lightning applies the Focus secondary arc. This is Focus-eligible and can occupy one slot in a Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Channel a concentrated burst of your chosen element, dealing high damage to a single target.

card.name: Cascade Storm
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three different creatures within 60 feet
card.effect: Cascade Storm. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, fire, cold, lightning, damage. Choose up to three creatures. Resolve one separate Mage spell attack against each: first hit deals S d6 fire and 1d4 fire next turn; second hit deals S d6 cold and Speed -10 feet until end next turn; third hit deals S d6 lightning and removes Reaction until start next turn. If fewer than three targets are chosen, unused elements are lost. For Nuke Chain purposes choose one of the three elements before casting; Cascade Storm counts only as that element.

source.originalText: Cascade Storm: Trigger a sequence of elemental effects that build upon each other.

text: Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

card.name: Reflected Repertoire
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 records currently in your archive
card.effect: Mark up to 3 distinct existing records. Each one's next release keeps its record instead of consuming it; still pay release RP and obey one release/round. No restoration of already empty slots, no invented records, no reuse-preservation after its marked use.

source.originalText: Final – Reflected Repertoire: Reset all Echo slots. Next 3 Echoes cast without consuming slots.

text: STUN GUARD. A creature can be Stunned by your Monk features at most once per encounter. Mark it after the first Monk-caused Stunned condition successfully applies. If another of your Monk features would Stun that marked creature later in the same encounter, the creature still makes the required save; on failure it instead loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This guard is tracked separately for each Monk.

Each technique tagged weave creates 1 D in this pilot, unless it explicitly says otherwise. Ki can prevent up to 1 D before resolution only if remaining Ki pays that additional cost. Full-Ki capstones may legally accept D. The Stun Guard shares the suite-wide once/character/target hard-denial mark; its later failed-save fallback of reaction loss is an explicit Monk exception, not a second Stun.

card.name: Stunning Strike
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
card.effect: Stunning Strike. Tags: base, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the common Monk Stun Guard. On success it suffers only the strike's normal damage. A creature already marked by your Stun Guard instead loses its Reaction on a failed save.

source.originalText: Stunning Strike: Channel ki into a precise strike that can temporarily paralyze an opponent if they fail to resist.

card.name: Nerve Strike
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Nerve Strike. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose one: its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, or it loses its Reaction and cannot take Bonus Actions during that period. This causes no permanent nerve injury.

source.originalText: Nerve Strike: Target critical pressure points to temporarily disable an opponent's abilities or movement.

card.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon II
card.effect: resistance to explicitly time/aging damage and advantage on saves against aging/slow effects; once per encounter spend 1 RC after another creature finishes its turn to take one additional full Action immediately, subject to the global action cap.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

value.source: rulebook — Example Curse: Spiral-Touched (only full curse tree in player rulebook)

card.name: Bloodline Convergence
card.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls, reduce the first damage they take each round by S and are immune to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Ancestor Revelation for 0 RC; it still uses its normal action type. When Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required. At most three chosen allies gain its aura. The free Tier I activation uses its ordinary action type and shares the two-Revelation ceiling.

value.name: Bloodline Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, +2 actions per turn (Revelation or movement only); allies within 5 tiles gain +10% crit, +5% DR, immunity to Fear; cast 1 Revelation per round at no cost. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

card.name: Mark of the Doomed
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy you can see within 5 tiles
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one active mark at a time
card.effect: Mark the target. You and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 on attack rolls against it. The first critical hit against the marked creature during the mark deals +1d6 damage of the triggering attack's type. The marked creature cannot benefit from mundane concealment against you. Applying another Mark of the Doomed ends the previous mark.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Mark of the Doomed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy you can see for 2 rounds — you and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 to hit and +10% crit chance against them; the first attack that crits the mark deals +1d6 bonus damage and the marked target cannot benefit from concealment until the mark fades.

card.name: Fury of the Host
card.effect: For 2 rounds, each ally in range may once on its regular turn gain one additional full Action usable only for one ordinary weapon attack or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies also gain +1 on attack rolls and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. You gain +2 AC and immunity to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Battle Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. The first qualifying ally each round to reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP regains 1d6 HP. When the effect ends, you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attacks and saves and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required; choose at most three allies for its benefits. Each granted Action may make only one ordinary weapon attack or Dash, and cannot grant another action.

value.name: Fury of the Host
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +1 action per turn (attack or move only), +10% crit chance, and +5% DR as the War Chorus banners them — you gain +2 AC and immunity to Fear; once per round you may cast one Tier I Battle Revelation at no cost, and the first ally to drop an enemy each round regains 1d6 HP. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

card.name: Bone Whisper
card.cost: 1 RC for active suppression; corpse speech costs 0 RC
card.rangeAndTarget: One corpse touched; undead within 2 tiles for active effect
card.duration: Corpse conversation maximum 1 minute; suppression until end of your next turn
card.frequency: Corpse speech 1/corpse; active at will while RC remains
card.effect: You may ask a corpse up to three brief questions about events it personally perceived while alive; it answers from its own knowledge and cannot speculate. Separately, spend 1 RC as an Action; undead enemies within 2 tiles make Wisdom saves. On failure they would be Incapacitated until the end of your next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. On a later qualifying failure after the guard has been used, they instead lose Reactions and their Speed becomes 0 for that duration.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Bone Whisper
value.description: Passive: speak with corpses and recent dead as if under Speak with Dead. Active: spend 1 charge to learn one hidden truth a corpse witnessed before death; undead within 2 tiles must save or become unable to act until end of your next turn as the Pale Ledger speaks through the bones.

card.name: Unfinished Chorus
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemies, controlled undead and corpses within 4 tiles
card.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Once on each of your turns choose one living enemy in range; it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you either regain half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, or one living ally within 3 tiles of you regains that amount, maximum S+M HP. Undead you control add S damage to one attack each turn and reduce first damage each round by 1. Corpses in the area cannot be raised while the Chorus lasts. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet. Choose up to three enemies and three allies. Enemies make Wisdom saves on entry and at the end of each turn, ending their debuff on success. The drain allows a Constitution save for half damage; healing is capped at S+M total per pulse. Concentration and pulse upkeep apply.

value.name: Unfinished Chorus
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) as the Pale Ledger sings their unfinished deaths — once per round drain 1d6 HP from one target (heal half or redirect half to an ally within 3 tiles); undead you control gain +10% damage and +5% DR, and corpses within 4 tiles cannot be raised as undead until the chorus ends. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% necrotic resist for 1 round).

card.name: Bones Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Marrow Drain: a living target hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Ledger's Command: may target up to 3 undead, but all controlled undead still share one Bonus Action command per round. Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: when its drain resolves, you may always redirect the healing to one ally within 3 tiles of you rather than yourself; its healing cap remains S+M.

value: Enhanced Marrow Drain: also slows target movement by 1 tile
Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: you may redirect drained HP to an ally within 3 tiles

card.name: Tremor Sense
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles for tremor
card.duration: Permanent; tremor penalties until end of your next turn
card.effect: While touching the ground or a structure, you can identify obvious structural instability, hollow spaces and hidden passages within 3 tiles that transmit vibration, subject to ordinary concealment and construction. Reduce the first bludgeoning damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest as an Action, enemies within 2 tiles make Strength saves; on failure they fall Prone, and on success their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of your next turn.

value.name: Tremor Sense
value.description: Passive: detect structural instability and hidden passages within 3 tiles, and +5% resistance to bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, cause a minor tremor — enemies within 2 tiles must save or fall prone; on success they still suffer −1 movement until your next turn.

card.name: Shardburst
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; Speed reduction until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If a failing creature is adjacent to a wall, rubble or substantial stone terrain, it also makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Shardburst
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt stone shards in a 2-tile burst centered on a point within 4 tiles — enemies take 1d6 bludgeoning and suffer −1 movement for 1 round; on a failed save they also fall prone if adjacent to a wall or rubble.

card.name: Gale of Unmaking
card.duration: Damage/movement instantaneous; difficult terrain until start of your next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the line make Strength saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 1 tile on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Failed targets also have Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of their next turn. Mundane exposed flames in the line are extinguished. Loose natural debris in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Gale of Unmaking
value.description: Spend 1 charge: unleash a 4-tile line of forceful wind — enemies in the path take 1d6 bludgeoning, are pushed 1 tile, and suffer −1 movement until your next turn; mundane flames are extinguished and loose debris becomes difficult terrain for 1 round.

card.name: Seal's Fracture
card.effect: Choose Earthquake, Storm or Fire. The zone becomes difficult terrain. At activation and at the start of your next regular turn, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage on failure or half on success: bludgeoning for Earthquake, lightning for Storm, fire for Fire. Until the zone ends, enemies inside take -1 on saving throws against your Cataclysm Revelations; allies inside reduce first damage each round by 1 and cannot be knocked Prone by this zone. Difficult terrain expands 1 tile outward after the second pulse but deals no extra damage there. Structures may crack at Director discretion. When the effect ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

value.name: Seal's Fracture
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per turn create a 4-tile cataclysm zone (earthquake, storm, or fire — choose when cast) as the Shattered Seal weeps — enemies inside take 2d6 damage each round and suffer −10% saves; allies inside gain +5% DR and cannot be knocked prone by the zone; difficult terrain spreads 1 tile outward each round and structures inside may crack (DM discretion). After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

card.name: Wrathful Brand
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
card.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Wrathful Brand
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

card.name: Passion's Rush
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; move up to 3 tiles in a straight or bending legal path
card.duration: Movement instantaneous; ally buff until start of your next turn
card.effect: Move up to 3 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. Each meaningful hostile creature whose space you pass adjacent to can be affected once and makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; a failed target also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If you finish adjacent to an ally, that ally adds S damage to its next weapon hit and reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Passion's Rush
value.description: Spend 1 charge: blaze up to 3 tiles in a line of harmless fire — enemies passed take 1d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −1 movement until your next turn; if you end adjacent to an ally, they gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 1 round as embers cling to their weapons.

card.name: Resonant Seed
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
card.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

card.name: Thorned Shelter
card.effect: The target gains +2 AC and reduces the first damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when it receives HP healing from another finite effect, add 1 HP. The first melee attacker to damage it each round takes 1d4 piercing damage and must make a Strength save; on failure its Speed becomes 0 until the end of that current turn. This movement restriction is not a full-turn denial.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Thorned Shelter
value.description: Spend 1 charge: thorned vines erupt around one ally within 3 tiles — +2 AC, +10% DR, and +5% healing received for 2 rounds; the first melee attacker each round takes 1d4 piercing and cannot move away from the sheltered ally until end of turn.

card.name: Marquis's Glimpse
card.effect: For 3 rounds, ranged attack rolls against you automatically miss unless the attacker is adjacent to you or has an effect explicitly ignoring supernatural concealment. Once on each of your turns when a psychic Revelation deals damage, add a second copy of its unmodified rolled damage dice to one target; this copied damage cannot trigger RC recovery, conditions or proc effects. At the start of each enemy's turn within 4 tiles it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. text: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

Elemental Attunement is defensive; Elemental Imbue is the separate Pathfinder feature gated 6. Imbue Bonus Action 2 RP, one element for 3 of your turns; once/turn a weapon hit adds 1d4 of chosen element plus fire:Burn 1d4 next target turn, cold:Speed-10 ft until end next turn, poison:CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn. Nonstacking; Do Ts never build Hit Chain. Switching element pays again.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. text: Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

card.name: Suppression Fire
card.effect: Up to 3 perceived enemies in zone make DEX save. Failure: S d6 piercing and Speed-10 ft through end next turn; success half damage, no slow. Cannot shoot through full cover. No attack rolls or on-hit procs.

source.originalText: Suppression Fire: Create a zone that enemies must save against or take damage when entering.

card.name: Hold the Line
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy entering your melee reach
card.effect: Make one melee weapon attack. On hit normal damage and STR save or Speed 0. This is soft movement control; teleportation and forced movement remain possible.

source.originalText: Hold the Line: Establish a defensive position that grants bonuses to allies behind you.

card.name: Divine Lockdown
card.effect: STR save each; failure Speed 0 and cannot take Reactions. Success Speed-10 ft only. This is physical suppression; teleport remains possible. No damage or additional free attacks.

source.originalText: Divine Lockdown: Prevent enemy movement in a small area (once per encounter).

card.name: Marked for Death
card.effect: Mark foe. It takes-1 saves against your class effects and deals 1 less damage on its first hit against an ally other than you. One mark; penalty does not stack with Intimidating Presence.

source.originalText: Marked for Death: Enemies you designate take –1 to saves and deal –1 damage vs allies other than you.

card.name: Crippling Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy hit by your Sneak Attack
card.effect: Target CON save; failure Speed halved. Does not stack multiple slow fractions or deny teleport. Explicit Arch minimum 15 retained.

source.originalText: Crippling Strike: Your Sneak Attack applies Slow effect to the target (level 15).

card.name: Vein Cutter
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemy critically hit by your weapon
card.effect: Consume prepared poison without its normal recipe effect; target CON save or Bleed 1d4 next 2 turns, Speed-10 ft and-1 next attack damage. Reapplication refreshes; source stack 3 replaced by one bounded package.

source.originalText: Vein Cutter: On critical hit, apply Bleed, Slow, and Weakened effects that can stack up to 3 times.

card.name: Crippling Lash
card.effect: Make one weapon attack. If it qualifies for Sneak, CON save or Speed-10 ft and-1 damage on next weapon hit for duration. No extra Sneak packet.

source.originalText: Crippling Lash: Your Sneak Attack slows the target and reduces their damage by -1 for 2 rounds.

text: At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Defensive: Target Taunter command action once/encounter WIS save one foe 30 ft or disadvantage attacking others until end next turn; Energy Shield command gives adjacent ally+2 AC until start next turn; Smoke Cloud command once/encounter creates 5 ft radius opaque smoke centered drone until start next turn. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Bomb stock refills during long rest with tools to 3 at 1, 4 at 5, 5 at 11; cap equals refill, class bombs have no resale or stockpiling. Encounter throw cap 1 at 1, 2 at 5, 3 at 11. Each throw uses one stock and one encounter allowance. Basic fire/cold known 1; advanced profiles known 6; Overload Core known 9. Base throw is Action, range 30 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures, DEX save S d6 element, half success. Fire failure adds 1d4 Burn next turn; cold failure Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Explosive Handling makes throw Bonus Action; still only one bomb/regular turn. At 15 Danger Close automatically allows excluding yourself/allies. Safe Detonation grants this early. Bombs cannot critically hit or inherit weapon riders.

Advanced bomb profiles replace basic rider: Thermobaric fire pushes 5 ft on failed STR save after damage; Cryo cold on failed DEX also Speed 0 until end next turn and d2=2 ignores 1 flat DR against this bomb; Shock lightning CON instead DEX, failure prevents verbal spellcasting until end next turn (construct instead loses Reactions), shared hard-denial guard; Glue no damage, 15 ft square difficult terrain 3 rounds and entering/starting DEX save or Speed-15 ft until end turn, once per creature/round. Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

card.name: Bomb Specialization
card.effect: Add M damage to one target that failed its initial save. No multiplying by area targets or damage ticks; Glue instead increases its slow by 5 ft maximum 20.

source.originalText: Bomb Specialization: Your explosive devices deal additional damage or have enhanced effects.

card.name: Deploy Net Trap
card.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

card.name: Overpressure Bombs
card.effect: Add on failed initial save STR save or choose push 10 ftor Prone. Also add S damage to one failed-save target. No additional blast or compounded slow; do not stack with Thermobaric push.

source.originalText: Overpressure Bombs: Your bombs gain knockback or prone effects with enhanced elemental damage.

text: STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

card.name: Brutality Sense
card.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
card.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

card.name: Brutality Momentum
card.effect: Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

card.name: Stabilizing Injection
card.frequency: At most once per target per long rest
card.effect: Stabilizing Injection. The target regains 2d8 + M HP and may end one of Poisoned, Frightened or Staggered. If Diseased, it may immediately repeat one saving throw the disease normally permits. This removes no Wounds, cannot restore the dead and does not activate a mutation or apply the consumed serum's normal profile.

source.originalText: Stabilizing Injection: Use your serum knowledge to create a stabilizing agent that can heal and remove negative status effects.

card.name: Cellular Reconstruction
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery
card.effect: Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.

source.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

card.name: Stonecore
card.effect: Gain +2 AC and immunity to forced movement or knockback from creatures no more than one size larger. Side effect: Speed -10 feet. Serum Tolerance suppresses the Speed penalty.

source.originalText: | Stonecore | +2 AC | Immunity to knockback | 3 rounds | -15% Speed |

text: MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

card.name: Analyze Magic
card.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
card.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Will Domination
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature that fails a save against your Wizard spell by 5 or more
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Will Domination. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, control. When a creature's total on a saving throw against your Wizard spell is at least 5 below the DC, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn. After this successfully Stuns that creature once in the encounter, later qualifying failures instead remove its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This uses the shared source-character/target hard-denial mark across all your features, not a separate allowance per spell.

source.originalText: Will Domination: Creatures that fail saves against your spells by 5+ are stunned for 1 round.

card.name: Binding Sigil
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature directly affected by your Wizard spell
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most one marked creature at a time
card.effect: Binding Sigil. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, mark. After one creature takes damage from or fails a save against your Wizard spell, you may mark it. Until the end of your next regular turn you have advantage on Wizard spell attacks against that creature. Marking another creature ends the previous mark. Echoes, companions and environmental damage cannot apply it.

source.originalText: Binding Sigil: Mark a creature, giving you advantage on spell attacks against it.

card.name: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock)
card.effect: Infernal Pact — Gravebrand. Tags: hero, necromancer, infernal, necrotic, dark-content. This card can be selected only after completing the campaign's Infernal Pact quest and its dark-trauma check-in. Mark one creature. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the actual damage dealt, maximum S+M; success ends Gravebrand. Gravebrand ignores necrotic resistance but not immunity. While you possess this Pact, Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise may also treat Fiend corpses as eligible; other creature types remain ineligible.

source.originalText: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock): Grants Gravebrand: 1d6 necrotic per round, heals caster, overrides corpse resistance

card.name: Mental Binding
card.effect: Mental Binding. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure becomes Charmed for at most 3 rounds, repeat save at end each turn and on damage. On its first affected turn only, choose Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel or Strike; target uses up to half Speed, one object interaction or one ordinary weapon attack as appropriate, consuming its normal Action only if an attack is made. This command replaces at most one normal Action/turn and uses the shared hard-denial mark. Later turns retain normal actions, but while Charmed it cannot willingly attack you. No self-harm, compelled beliefs, resource expenditure or permanent allegiance. The player chooses the safest legal interpretation for a PC.

source.originalText: Mental Binding: Force a creature to obey a simple command for a short duration.

card.name: Arcane Domination
card.effect: Arcane Domination. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure Charmed for 1 minute, repeat at end each turn and on damage. Once during this effect, spend Bonus Action to command its NEXT normal turn: Move up to Speed and either Dodge, Disengage or make one ordinary weapon attack, replacing its normal Action and using the shared hard-denial mark. It gains no extra turn or attack; later turns retain normal actions while Charmed, with no Reactions until effect ends. A PC chooses its legal attack target and reasonable route. No self-harm, forced spell/resource expenditure, belief change or permanent control.

source.originalText: Arcane Domination: Take control of a creature's actions for 1 minute.

card.name: Mind Prison
card.effect: Mind Prison. Tags: hero, necromancer, final-theorem, enchantment, illusion, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure Incapacitated until end of its NEXT normal turn, using the shared hard-denial mark. During that one turn you may spend a Bonus Action on your turn to specify one replacement behavior: target moves up to half Speed and either Dodges or makes one ordinary weapon attack instead of its lost Action; a PC chooses its own attack target and route. After that first affected turn, no further Action denial or compelled attack occurs: while concentration continues, target Speed is halved and it cannot take Reactions. It repeats WIS save at end each turn and on damage, ending on success. Maximum 3 rounds. No forced self-harm, spell expenditure, transfer of equipment, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

source.originalText: Mind Prison: Trap a creature's mind in an illusory reality while controlling its body (1/week).
